outcome: Human milk phospholipid (PL) composition (choline-containing PL species)
cohort: The study analyzed 628 human milk samples collected from mothers participating in the Norwegian Human Milk Study birth-cohort.
finding: Maternal prepregnancy BMI was significantly associated with human milk fatty acid composition (n3-LCPUFA, n6/n3LCPUFA ratio, monounsaturated FA) and some phospholipid species (LysoPC16:1, LysoPC18:1), but not with choline-containing PL classes.
